query:
INSERT INTO project_members (project_id, email, role)
               VALUES ($1, $2, $3)
               ON CONFLICT(project_id, email) DO UPDATE SET
                   role = excluded.role
               RETURNING project_id as "project_id!: Uuid",
                         email,
                         role,
                         created_at as "created_at!: DateTime<Utc>"
